articles.title: 4 unproven Patriots players who are standing out at training camp
articles.description:
“I think that those guys are the ones that have the first crack at it."

The post 4 unproven Patriots players who are standing out at training camp appeared first on Boston.com.
summary: Four unproven Patriots players are making strong impressions at training camp.
Rookie Eli Raridon is among those standing out as camp progresses.
Increased competition may enhance team performance for Boston fans this season.
